name: notebook-workspace
description: YouTube -> handwritten revision notes: Express + BullMQ + Gemini API, with a React neo-brutalist notebook UI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix server run worker" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
